fasterflight.config.title: FasterFlight Settings
fasterflight.config.speedMultiplier.tool: How much faster you fly while the boost key is held. From 1.0x to 25.0x.
fasterflight.config.boostKey.tooltip: Hold this key to fly at the multiplier speed. Same keybind as the Controls page.
fasterflight.config.openConfigKey.toolti: Opens this settings screen in game. Unbound by default; same keybind as the Controls page.
fasterflight.config.showIndicator.toolti: Shows the active multiplier above the hotbar while boosting.
